result.markdown:
# Planned Fibre Maintenance and Parameter Changes in the South

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-SUD-02-B`
- **Confidence:** low (Directly evidenced by matching maintenance window MW-0013 and expected downstream impact on S-SUD-005 and S-SUD-007.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-29 15:15 to 2026-09-29 23:33
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-29 16:08
- **Affected:** S-SUD-001, S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005, S-SUD-007, LNK-SUD-02-B

## Summary

Planned fibre splice work on transport link LNK-SUD-02-B caused downstream sites S-SUD-005 and S-SUD-007 to go offline during the maintenance window.

Planned fibre maintenance caused downtime on two sites, while parameter changes caused minor RRC failure rates on two other sites.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-29 15:15: Alert ALR-0039 began affecting four sites in the South region. [ALR-0039]
- 2026-09-29 15:27: Parameter optimisation batch applied to S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-004. [CHG-2026-0080, CHG-2026-0081]
- 2026-09-29 16:08: Planned fibre splice work started on LNK-SUD-02-B and minor RRC failure rate alarm raised. [MW-0013, ALM-000602]
- 2026-09-29 16:14: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SUD-005 and S-SUD-007 during maintenance. [ALM-000604, ALM-000605]
- 2026-09-29 19:16: Planned maintenance on LNK-SUD-02-B completed. [MW-0013]
- 2026-09-29 23:26: Rollback of parameter changes on S-SUD-004 and S-SUD-001. [CHG-2026-0082, CHG-2026-0083]
- 2026-09-29 23:33: Minor alarm cleared on S-SUD-004 and alert ALR-0039 ended. [ALM-000602, ALR-0039]

## Evidence

- Alert ALR-0039 affected S-SUD-001, S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-007. [ALR-0039]
- Maintenance window MW-0013 ran on fiber link LNK-SUD-02-B from 16:08 to 19:16 on 2026-09-29. [MW-0013]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms occurred on S-SUD-005 and S-SUD-007 during the fibre maintenance. [ALM-000604, ALM-000605]
- Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-004 at 15:27 and rolled back. [CHG-2026-0080, CHG-2026-0081, CHG-2026-0082, CHG-2026-0083]
- Minor alarm RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH occurred on S-SUD-004 from 16:08 to 23:33. [ALM-000602]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SUD-02-B: confirmed. Planned maintenance window MW-0013 explicitly covered the downtime of S-SUD-005 and S-SUD-007. [MW-0013, ALM-000604, ALM-000605]
2. **bad_change** at S-SUD-001: confirmed. Parameter tuning changes executed on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-004 caused RRC failures until rolled back. [CHG-2026-0080, CHG-2026-0081, ALM-000602]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0080: Parameter tuning changes caused RRC failure rates on S-SUD-001 and S-SUD-004, but did not cause the total site drops on S-SUD-005 and S-SUD-007.

## Recommended actions

- Verify transport link redundancy and routing policies for sites S-SUD-005 and S-SUD-007.
- Review parameter optimization batch OPT-21 before future deployments to prevent RRC regressions.

- `ALR-0039`: ended alert from 2026-09-29 15:15: 4 site(s) (S-SUD-001, S-SUD-004, S-SUD-005, S-SUD-007); region-level SUD; metrics: active_users, availability_pct, dl_volume_mb, dro...

- `CHG-2026-0081`: parameter_tuning on S-SUD-004 at 2026-09-29 15:27: Scheduled parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 applied to S-SUD-004 [ROLLED BACK by CHG-2026-0082 at 2026-09-29 23:26]
- `MW-0013`: completed window 2026-09-29 16:08 -> 2026-09-29 19:16 on LNK-SUD-02-B: Planned fibre splice work on LNK-SUD-02-B; expected impact: Downstream sites offline during spli...
- `ALM-000602`: minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH on S-SUD-004, raised 2026-09-29 16:08, cleared 2026-09-29 23:33
- `ALM-000604`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SUD-005, raised 2026-09-29 16:14, cleared 2026-09-29 19:09
- `ALM-000605`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SUD-007, raised 2026-09-29 16:14, cleared 2026-09-29 19:09
- `CHG-2026-0082`: rollback of CHG-2026-0081 on S-SUD-004 at 2026-09-29 23:26: Rollback of OPT-21 on S-SUD-004 after KPI regression escalated by NOC
- `CHG-2026-0083`: rollback of CHG-2026-0080 on S-SUD-001 at 2026-09-29 23:28: Rollback of OPT-21 on S-SUD-001 after KPI regression escalated by NOC
